_note: Posts dated on/before reviewed_through were part of the initial bulk pull to the instagram-images branch and are NOT treated as new. Each weekly run considers posts newer than this date (and any shortcode not already listed below). Decisions are add | replace | skip; a replace also records what came out and why it lost. Site edits from the critical-review step that are not tied to a post (stale copy fixed, weak/redundant items removed) go under trimmed. After each run, advance reviewed_through to the newest post seen and append every considered post. runs records one entry per weekly run; a run whose detection was blocked leaves reviewed_through where it is so the next run re-checks from the same point.

incorporated.reason: Owner asked for the Spring Awakening Fashion Statement Windows in Bentonville, with artist Muoi Le, to go on the site. It is a distinct body of work (window and installation design, an artist collaboration) that no existing case covers, so it grows the Work cases from 4 to 5, one past the budget, rather than replacing a case that still earns its place. Rewritten out of the employer's "our" voice into Quentin's own, per the personal-site rule. Correction after publishing: the first draft read 'Commissioned artist Muoi Le', which the owner flagged as wrong. His role was styling the looks in the windows, not commissioning the artist, so 'What I did' now claims the styling only and credits the installations to Muoi Le. The owner then supplied ten photos of the installation: the case tile is the storefront bay cropped to 4:5, six more became the Archives Commercial shoot 'Spring Awakening windows' (3 shoots to 4, still under the 5-to-10 budget), and three were dropped, a duplicate, a near-repeat of the chambray frame, and a wide sales-floor shot with shoppers and a barista in it that is store interior rather than window work. Second correction: 'styled every look in the windows' overstated the scope, since a coworker styled another window. The row now reads concept input, merchandising, and styling one window, and the problem/result rows carry the actual goal: shifting what people assume about Walmart fashion, and setting that bar internally first since the windows stand where the collection teams walk past them.
